summary: Monolith architecture: React Native (Expo) frontend, Python (Django) backend, PostgreSQL database on Google Cloud (Cloud Run + Cloud SQL).

frontend.justification: Matches team language(s): javascript. One JavaScript/TypeScript codebase ships Android + iOS. Expo removes most native tooling pain.

alternatives.why_not: Needs dart, which the team does not list.
Needs kotlin, which the team does not list.

tradeoffs: Some native modules require ejecting from Expo.
Performance below fully native for heavy graphics.

backend.justification: Matches team language(s): python. Batteries included: admin, ORM, auth, migrations. Very fast MVP delivery with sane defaults.

supporting.choice: SQLite on-device store + background sync API
supporting.justification: Offline-first mobile: field data is captured into an embedded SQLite store on the device and synced to the server database when connectivity returns (append-only sync with server-side conflict rules).
tradeoffs: Sync conflicts need explicit resolution rules.
